states.selectPrompt: SELECT A STATUS EFFECT TA INSPECT!

desc.Doom: COUNTS DOWN THREE TURNS, DEN TAKES CURSED DAMAGE WORTH 60% OF ITS MAXIMUM HEALTH, 20% ON A BOSS. A CURE IN TIME LIFTS IT!

desc.Fresh Magazine: A FULL MAGAZINE JUST SLAMMED HOME. DA NEXT SHOT IZ LIKELIER TA LAND AN' TA CRIT; FIRIN' IT SPENDS DA EDGE!
desc.Dead: KNOCKED OUT. DA BATTLER IZ DOWN AN' TAKES NO TURN UNTIL IT IZ REVIVED!
desc.Guard: GUARDIN'. DAMAGE TAKEN DIS TURN IZ HALVED!
desc.Immortal: NO CAN BE REDUCED BELOW ONE HIT POINT WHILE IT LASTS!
desc.Edge Stance: EVERY PHYSICAL ATTACK AN' SKILL LANDS AS CUTTIN' DAMAGE: BLUNT BLOWS CUT AN' SEVER LIMBS. AIM SUFFERS FOR IT!
desc.Merciful Stance: EVERY PHYSICAL ATTACK AN' SKILL LANDS AS BLUNT DAMAGE: VITAL PARTS IZ SPARED AN' A FOE BROUGHT TA ZERO IZ LEFT DOWNED, NO DEAD. DA BLOWS LAND WEAKER!

desc.Poison: LOSES 5% OF ITS MAXIMUM HEALTH AT DA END OF EVERY TURN. A FIRE HIT BOILS IT INTO FUMES DAT CAUSE NAUSEA ON IT AN' DOZE BESIDE IT!
desc.Blind: ACCURACY DROPS BY HALF: PHYSICAL ATTACKS MISS FAR MORE OFTEN!
desc.Silence: MAGIC IZ SEALED. SPELLS NO CAN BE CAST UNTIL IT LIFTS!
desc.Rage: ATTACKS A RANDOM BAD 'UN, BUT DEALS 50% MORE DAMAGE!
desc.Confusion: ACTS AT RANDOM AN' MAY HIT MATES AS READILY AS FOES!
desc.Charm: FIGHTS FOR DA OTHER SIDE UNTIL DA CHARM BREAKS!
desc.Sleep: NO CAN ACT AN' NO CAN EVADE. TAKIN' DAMAGE TENDS TA WAKE IT!
desc.Freeze: NO CAN ACT. A PHYSICAL BLOW SHATTERS DA ICE FOR HALF AGAIN ITS DAMAGE; A FIRE HIT THAWS IT AN' LEAVES DA TARGET WET!
desc.Paralysis: NO CAN ACT AN' NO CAN EVADE FOR DA NEXT THREE TURNS!
desc.Stun: LOSES ITS NEXT TURN OR TWO. NO ACTION, NO EVASION!
desc.Locked on: CRITICAL HITS LAND THREE TIMES AS OFTEN AN' PHYSICAL BLOWS NO CAN BE DODGED. SOME TECHNIQUES SPEND IT!
desc.HP Regeneration: RECOVERS 10% OF ITS MAXIMUM HEALTH AT DA END OF EVERY TURN!
desc.MP Regeneration: RECOVERS 10% OF ITS MAXIMUM MAGIC AT DA END OF EVERY TURN!
desc.AP Regeneration: RECOVERS 10% OF ITS ACTION POINTS AT DA END OF EVERY TURN!
desc.Magic Reflection: SPELLS CAST AT IT BOUNCE BACK AT DA CASTER!
desc.Protect: TAKES HITS AIMED AT A WOUNDED ALLY INSTEAD OF DEM!
desc.Provoke: TARGETED NINE TIMES AS OFTEN AS ANYONE ELSE. A FOE IT IZ THROWN ON AIMS EVERY SINGLE-TARGET ACTION AT WHOEVER PROVOKED IT!
desc.Hide: OUT OF SIGHT. BAD 'UNS WILL NO PICK IT AS A TARGET. AN AMBUSH FROM HIDIN' SPENDS IT!
desc.Counter Attack: ANSWERS EVERY PHYSICAL ATTACK WIT ONE OF ITS OWN!
desc.Status Ailment Block: IMMUNE TA POISON, BLINDNESS, SILENCE, RAGE, CONFUSION, CHARM, SLEEP, FREEZE, PARALYSIS, STUN, BURNS, BLEEDIN', GRAPPLES, PINS, GUARD BREAKS, WINDIN' AN' CONCUSSION!
desc.Inspired: SPELLS COST A QUARTER LESS MAGIC!
desc.Hot: ATTACKS DEAL FIRE. ICE DAMAGE TAKEN IZ DOUBLED. AGILITY RISES. AN ICE HIT TURNS DA HEAT TA STEAM: DA AURA IZ LOST AN' DA CARRIER IZ BLIND!
desc.Cold: ATTACKS DEAL ICE. FIRE DAMAGE TAKEN IZ TRIPLED, THUNDER DAMAGE HALVED!
desc.Static: ATTACKS DEAL LIGHTNING. LIGHTNING DAMAGE TAKEN IZ HALVED!
desc.Wet: ATTACKS DEAL WATER. FIRE DAMAGE TAKEN IZ HALVED, LIGHTNING DAMAGE DOUBLED. A THUNDER HIT DRIES IT INTO PARALYSIS; AN ICE HIT MAY FREEZE IT SOLID!
desc.Half Encounters: WANDERIN' MONSTERS IZ MET HALF AS OFTEN WHILE WALKIN'!
desc.Double Money/Items: A WON FIGHT PAYS TWICE DA MONEY AN' DROPS TWICE DA LOOT!
desc.Berserk: ATTACKS AT RANDOM, 50% HARDER, WIT DEFENCE DOWN BY A THIRD!
desc.Divine Shield: ALL INCOMIN' DAMAGE IZ CUT BY 30% AN' CRITICAL HITS NO CAN LAND!
desc.Death Mark: TAKES 30% MORE DAMAGE FROM EVERYTINK AN' IZ TARGETED FIRST!
desc.Perfect Focus: EVERY HIT IZ A CRITICAL AN' NO PHYSICAL BLOW MISSES, BUT DEFENCE DROPS BY A FIFTH. SOME TECHNIQUES SPEND IT!

desc.Unbalanced: ACCURACY FALLS, AN' EVERY ACTION IT TAKES HAB A ONE IN FOUR CHANCE TA FAIL IN A STUMBLE!

desc.Burned: LOSES 10% OF ITS MAXIMUM HEALTH AT DA END OF EVERY TURN. A WATER HIT PUTS IT OUT; A WIND HIT FANS IT ONTO DOZE BESIDE IT!

desc.Floating: FASTER, TAKES HALF DAMAGE FROM PHYSICAL HITS AN' IZ IMMUNE TA EARTH, BUT LIGHTNING DOES DOUBLE DAMAGE!
desc.Invisible: ATTACKS AGAINST IT ALMOST ALWAYS MISS, AN' IT IZ RARELY PICKED AS A TARGET!
desc.Oily: FIRE DAMAGE TAKEN IZ TRIPLED. A FIRE HIT SETS DA OIL ALIGHT: DA CARRIER IZ BURNED, DA OIL BURNS AWAY AN' DA FLAMES LEAP TA OILY NEIGHBOURS!
desc.Bleeding: LOSES 10% OF ITS MAXIMUM HEALTH AT DA END OF EVERY TURN!
desc.Dodge: EVASION AGAINST WEAPONS AN' MAGIC ALIKE IZ DOUBLED!
desc.Withdrawal: ATTACK, MAGIC AN' AGILITY ALL FALL, AN' ACCURACY SUFFERS!
desc.Grappled: AGILITY AN' EVASION COLLAPSE, AN' PHYSICAL BLOWS LAND A QUARTER HARDER!
desc.Pinned: NO CAN ACT. ONE SOLID HIT BREAKS IT FREE!
desc.Guard Broken: DEFENCE IZ HALVED, MAGIC DEFENCE FALLS, AN' GUARDIN' HAB NO EFFECT!
desc.Winded: SLOWER, AN' ALMOST NO ACTION POINTS BUILD UP WHILE IT LASTS!
desc.Combo: ACCURACY AN' CRITICAL RATE RISE. SOME TECHNIQUES DO FAR MORE DAMAGE FROM IT AN' SPEND IT!
desc.Vital Exposed: EVERY PHYSICAL BLOW DAT FOLLOWS DOES HALF AGAIN AS MUCH DAMAGE!
desc.Rooted: MUCH HARDER TA DAMAGE OR KNOCK OVER, BUT SLOWER!
desc.Flow: TURNS SOME ATTACKS ASIDE AN' COUNTERS DEM!
desc.Bullet Time: EVASION RISES BY A FIFTH. IN A TURN BATTLE'S BULLET HELL DODGE DA BAD 'UN FIRES HALF AS OFTEN AN' HALF AS FAST!
desc.Foresight: MAGIC EVASION RISES BY A FIFTH. IN A TURN BATTLE'S BULLET HELL DODGE DA CRAFT IZ FAR HARDER TA HIT!
desc.Chi Burn: LOSES HEALTH EACH TURN, MAGIC POWER FALLS AN' ACTION POINTS BUILD UP SLOWLY!
desc.Concussed: MAGIC POWER, MAGIC DEFENCE AN' ACCURACY ALL FALL!
desc.Allergic Reaction: HIVES, ITCHIN' AN' A RUNNIN' NOSE FROM AN ALLERGEN. ATTACK AN' AGILITY FALL AN' AIM SLIPS UNTIL IT PASSES OR AN ANTIHISTAMINE CLEARS IT!
desc.Anaphylaxis: DA AIRWAY SWELLS SHUT AFTER AN ALLERGEN. HEALTH DRAINS EVERY TURN AN' DA BODY BARELY ANSWERS UNTIL AN ANTIHISTAMINE OR A HEALTH POTION OPENS IT AGAIN!
desc.Brittle: RIMED THROUGH AN' SLOWER. DA NEXT PHYSICAL BLOW SHATTERS IT FOR 60% MORE DAMAGE; A FIRE HIT MELTS IT AWAY!
desc.Volatile: SOAKED IN A VOLATILE REAGENT. A FIRE HIT DETONATES IT FOR DOUBLE DAMAGE AN' LEAVES DA CARRIER AN' DOZE BESIDE IT BURNED; A THUNDER HIT SPARKS IT FOR HALF AGAIN!
desc.Hay Fever: STREAMIN' EYES AN' FITS OF SNEEZIN' FROM POLLEN IN DA AIR. SPELLS AN' AIM SUFFER UNTIL IT PASSES OR AN ANTIHISTAMINE CLEARS IT!
desc.Looped: REPEATS DA LAST ACTION IT TOOK, ON DA SAME TARGET WHERE DAT TARGET STILL STANDS, FOR ONE TA THREE OF ITS OWN ACTIONS!
desc.Mind Sealed: DA LAST SKILL IT USED IZ SEALED AN' NO CAN BE USED WHILE DIS LASTS!
desc.Rebound: DA NEXT SKILL AN OPPONENT LANDS ON IT IZ THROWN BACK AT WHOEVER CAST IT. PLAIN ATTACKS PASS THROUGH!
desc.Puppeted: ITS NEXT MOVE WAZ PICKED BY DA PSYCHIC WHO HOLDS DA STRINGS, AN' IT IZ AIMED AT ITS OWN SIDE!
desc.Turncoat: ITS NEXT ACTION IZ AIMED AT ITS OWN SIDE: BLOWS LAND ON ITS ALLIES, HELP GOES TA ITS FOES!
desc.Echo: DA NEXT SKILL IT USES FIRES A SECOND TIME AT DA SAME TARGET, AT NO COST!

body: DAT HOLDS A SHAPE ONLY FOR AS LONG AS IT IZ ANGRY
STACKED IN LOBES DAT BOIL AGAINST EACH OTHER
HEAVY ENOUGH TA PRESS ITS OWN PRINTS INTO STONE
DAT RUNS UPHILL WHEN NOBODY IZ LOOKIN' AT IT
COLD TA DA TOUCH AN' LIT FROM SOMEWHERE INSIDE
WEARIN' AN OIL FILM DAT TURNS COLOURS NO OIL TURNS
DAT POOLS, GATHERS ITSELF, AN' STANDS BACK UP
SEAMED WIT DA SLUDGE OF AN ENTIRE FIELD
grafts: LIMBS IT NEVER GREW IZ SET INTO IT AT EVERY ANGLE, STILL TWITCHIN'!
WINGS, JAWS AN' MACHINE PARTS SIT HALF-DROWNED IN DA SURFACE!
BONES OF A DOZEN SPECIES SURFACE AN' SINK AS IT MOVES!
IT WEARS DA ANATOMY OF EVERYTINK DA WELL TOOK DOWN WIT IT!
ANTLERS, MANDIBLES AN' A PISTON ARM WORK OUT OF TIME WIT ONE ANOTHER!
WHATEVER IT SWALLOWED IZ STILL TRYIN' TA WALK AWAY!
GRAFTED PARTS OPEN AN' CLOSE ON NUTTIN', REMEMBERIN' DEY OLD BODIES!
DA HEAP BRISTLES WIT CLAWS, STALKS AN' ONE REAL PATIENT EYE!
origin: IT CAME UP A CAPPED WELL AN' HAB BIN COMIN' UP EVER SINCE!
IT WAZ A RESERVE ON A BALANCE SHEET BEFORE IT WAZ A CREATURE!
NUTTIN' DRILLED IT; IT DRILLED ITSELF!
DA FIELD IT ROSE FROM IZ STILL LISTED AS PRODUCIN'!
IT ANSWERS TA A BARREL PRICE AN' NUTTIN' ELSE!
IT HAB BIN UNDER DA GROUND LONGER DEN DERE HAB BIN A GROUND!
SOMETINK DOWN DERE IZ REFININ', AN' DIS IZ WHAT IT EXPORTS!
IT IZ WHAT A LEASE LOOKS LIKE WHEN IT IZ FINALLY CALLED IN!
epithet: WHO NO CAN BE FLARED OFF

build: SOMETINK DA WORLD MADE ONCE AN' DID NO MAKE AGAIN!
A BODY ASSEMBLED OUT OF PARTS NO SINGLE SPECIES OWNS!
IT IZ DA WRONG SIZE FOR EVERYTINK AROUND IT, AN' ALWAYS HAB BIN!
NUTTIN' IN DA BOOK ACCOUNTS FOR IT, AN' DA BOOK HAB BIN CHECKED!
IT READS AS AN ORDINARY ANIMAL UNTIL YOU HAB WATCHED IT FOR A WHILE!
A SHAPE DAT LOOKS DRAWN FROM A DESCRIPTION RATHER DEN FROM LIFE!
IT CARRIES DA PROPORTIONS OF THREE CREATURES AN' DA MANNERS OF NONE!
WHATEVER IT IZ, DERE IZ EXACTLY ONE OF IT!
habit: IT KEEPS TA GROUND NOBODY CROSSES TWICE!
IT MOVES AT DA HOUR DA MAPS IZ NO BEING DRAWN!
IT HAB BIN WALKIN' DA SAME LINE ACROSS DA CONTINENT FOR YEARS!
IT GOES WHERE IT IZ GOING AN' DOES NO STOP TA BE LOOKED AT!
IT IZ NEVER FOUND WHERE IT WAZ LAST REPORTED!
IT WALKS IN DA OPEN AN' IZ SOMEHOW NEVER IN ANYBODY'S WAY!
IT GRAZES, HUNTS OR WAITS, AN' NO TWO WITNESSES AGREE WHICH!
IT KEEPS A DISTANCE DAT NEVER CHANGES, WHATEVER DA DISTANCE WAZ!
rumour: THREE PEOPLE HAB WRITTEN IT DOWN AN' NO TWO ACCOUNTS AGREE!
EVERY SIGHTIN' IZ SOMEBODY'S ONLY SIGHTIN'!
DA LAST PERSON TA SEE ONE STOPPED TRAVELLIN' AFTERWARDS!
IT IZ IN ONE FIELD GUIDE, IN DA MARGIN, IN PENCIL!
DERE IZ A REWARD POSTED FOR A PHOTOGRAPH AN' NOBODY HAB CLAIMED IT!
DA VILLAGE DAT NAMED IT HAB SINCE NAMED IT SOMETINK ELSE!
IT HAB A LOCAL NAME IN FOUR LANGUAGES AN' A PROPER ONE IN NONE!
WHOEVER MEETS IT IZ DA LAST PERSON WHO WILL!

biology: ITS CHEMISTRY IZ NO EARTH'S AN' DOES NO PRETEND TA BE!
IT IZ SYMMETRICAL ALONG AN AXIS NUTTIN' HERE IZ SYMMETRICAL ALONG!
WHAT IT USES FOR BLOOD RUNS AT A TEMPERATURE NUTTIN' HERE SURVIVES!
IT BREATHES SOMETINK, AN' DA SOMETINK IZ NO AIR!
ITS BODY REPEATS ONE ORGAN UNTIL DA REPETITION IZ DA ANIMAL!
IT HAB SENSE ORGANS FACIN' DIRECTIONS DAT OUGHT NO TA MATTER!
NUTTIN' 'BOUT IT IZ WARM, AN' NUTTIN' 'BOUT IT IZ SLOW!
IT GREW INTO WHATEVER SHAPE ITS GRAVITY WOULD ALLOW!
behaviour: IT ANSWERS MOVEMENT RATHER DEN SOUND!
IT HUNTS ON A SCHEDULE KEYED TA A DAY NOBODY HERE IZ LIVIN'!
IT HAB NO REACTION TA BEING LOOKED AT. DAT IN ITSELF TELLS YOU SOMETINK!
IT TREATS A LANDIN' PARTY AS WEATHER!
IT IZ TERRITORIAL 'BOUT GROUND IDENTICAL TA ALL DA OTHER GROUND!
IT SWARMS, DEN DOES NO, AN' DA CHANGE HAB NO VISIBLE CAUSE!
IT TRAVELS IN A FORMATION DAT HOLDS TA DA CENTIMETRE!
IT IZ WAITIN' FOR SOMETINK DAT HAB NO HAPPENED YET!
world: IT WAZ CATALOGUED ON DA FIRST LANDIN' DAT SURVIVED ONE!
ITS WORLD IZ LISTED AS HABITABLE, WHICH IZ A CLERICAL OPINION!
IT IZ DA ONLY TINK DAT MOVES FOR A HUNDRED KILOMETRES!
DA BIOSIGNATURE PROMISED SOMETINK LIKE DIS AN' UNDERSTATED IT!
IT BELONGS TA A WORLD DAT HAB NEVER HAB A VISITOR TWICE!
NUTTIN' ELSE ON ITS PLANET SHARES A SINGLE FEATURE WIT IT!
DA SURVEY DAT NAMED IT WAZ CUT SHORT!
IT IZ, AS FAR AS ANYBODY CAN PROVE, NATIVE!
